references.purpose: The spec: storage (section 2), the five events with hook points and dedupe keys, recipient rules, bell and preferences UI, retention, exact words in section 7, tests in section 8
The card: decisions already made, the six build steps in order, acceptance list
Schema home for the Notification and NotificationPreference models, the NotificationKind enum, User relations and BusinessSettings.notificationKeepDays
LEAD_NEW hook points: after createLead (public form) and after createLeadManually commit; the manual creator is never a recipient
QUOTE_VIEWED hook: the SENT to VIEWED compare-and-swap inside getEstimateForApproval; notify only when the claim count is 1
PAYMENT_FAILED hooks: after the webhook transactions commit in handleInvoicePaymentFailed and handleCheckoutSessionAsyncPaymentFailed, once per Stripe event
APPROVAL_REQUESTED hook: after storeRequest commits a NEW request, never on its ALREADY_WAITING early return
The kit TopBar where NotificationBell mounts; the bell glyph joins the kit Icon set
Settings catalog: the Advanced keep-days row is added here, and the existing yourNotificationsLink row is reconciled to point at /desk/account/notifications
Exhaustive backup policy: Notification maps to null, NotificationPreference to its backup key, or typecheck fails
Access-change purge: when access level or job role changes, notifications of kinds the person can no longer receive are deleted in the same transaction with an audit row

risk: Writes after public actions and Stripe webhooks: a notification failure must never fail the lead form, the quote view, signing or the webhook. The optional internal email rides the existing messaging switches; no live customer email or SMS is turned on by this card.
